=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:378-395 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The placeholder loop still does open-ended `{{NAME}}` env lookups (`${!placeholder_name}`) for untrusted bodies. The case arms at lines 337-356 never set a structural `_render_untrusted_body_mode` gate. Callers review_run_reviewers.sh:3059, :3213 and review_apply_fixes.sh:1946 set both untrusted-body flags.
  WHY: Env exposure depends only on the name and value denylist, so any non-denylisted env var (e.g. GITHUB_REPOSITORY, RUNNER_OS) can reach the LLM prompt. Severity disagreement: sonnet and luna said MAJOR, while gemini, minimax and glm said BLOCKER. The highest is used, mapped to critical.
- tests/test_render_prompt_foundation.py:425-467 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `test_render_prompt_sh_never_substitutes_credential_env_placeholders` runs only in trusted-template mode. It does not set `RENDER_PROMPT_INPUT_ALREADY_ASSEMBLED` or `RENDER_PROMPT_SKIP_SYNTAX_VALIDATION`.
  WHY: A regression that re-enables env substitution in untrusted-body mode would pass. Severity disagreement: gemini said MAJOR and minimax raised the same gap as a BLOCKER task gap.
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:219-237 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The credential-name denylist misses GITHUB_*, RUNNER_*, GIT_ASKPASS, SSH_*, GIT_CONFIG_*, CLAUDE_*, ANTHROPIC_* and CHECK_TRIAGE_* names.
  WHY: In untrusted-body mode these env vars still flow into the prompt. glm raised this only as a hardening suggestion (risk 2), and minimax rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:219-237 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The broad word list (AUTH, SESSION, etc.) would refuse future placeholders such as `{{AUTH_FLOW_ENABLED}}` and leave them literal.
  WHY: No shipped template is affected today, so this is a latent surprise only.
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:378-395 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: There is no test that the credential-name predicates handle placeholder names with unusual characters. The names are already constrained to `[A-Za-z0-9_]+`.
  WHY: The case is theoretical, and the failure mode would be a literal `{{NAME}}` plus a stderr NOTE.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Add an untrusted-body flag `_render_untrusted_body_mode`, set in the truthy arms of both `RENDER_PROMPT_INPUT_ALREADY_ASSEMBLED` and `RENDER_PROMPT_SKIP_SYNTAX_VALIDATION`. The env loop is skipped in that mode, so only the four explicit vars are substituted.
  expected_change_site: scripts/render_prompt.sh case arms at lines 337-356 and loop at lines 378-395
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: `_render_untrusted_body_mode` does not exist anywhere in the repo, the case arms only add RENDER_ARGS flags, and the loop runs unconditionally with only the denylist and value-shape guards. Severity: BLOCKER per minimax, MAJOR per the others.
- requirement: Add `test_render_prompt_sh_does_not_substitute_env_into_untrusted_body`, which sets both untrusted-body flags and asserts `{{RENDER_PROMPT_TEST_PLAIN_PROBE}}` and `{{GH_PAT}}` stay literal. Also add `test_render_prompt_sh_refuses_secret_like_env_placeholders`, and register both in `main()`.
  expected_change_site: tests/test_render_prompt_foundation.py after ~line 424, plus the `main()` registration near ~line 1632
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: Only `test_render_prompt_sh_never_substitutes_credential_env_placeholders` was added, and it sets neither untrusted-body flag. The second prescribed test is absent. Severity: BLOCKER per minimax, MAJOR per the others.
- requirement: Append a sentence to the changelog saying `render_prompt.sh` no longer fills credential-like or untrusted-body placeholders from the environment, with `Refs #9399, #9431, #9465` and no auto-close keywords.
  expected_change_site: changelog.d/9341-render-prompt-readable-errors.md
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The fragment is unchanged and ends "Refs #9210 and #9236.", with no mention of the placeholder behaviour or the three issues. Severity: MAJOR per minimax, NIT per the others.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:378-395 (also case arms 337-356) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The structural gate was not implemented. The loop still reads `${!placeholder_name}` for any placeholder name, guarded only by the name denylist and the whole-value token-shape check. Callers review_run_reviewers.sh:3059 and :3213 and review_apply_fixes.sh:1946 set both flags.
  WHY: A PR author's `{{SOME_ENV_NAME}}` leaks any env value whose name misses the denylist and whose value is not token-shaped.
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:219-237 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The broad word list (KEY|KEYS|PAT|PASS|PWD|AUTH|SESSION|SIGNING|SIGNATURE|CERT|DSN|URI|CF|OTP) would refuse future placeholders such as `{{AUTH_FLOW_ENABLED}}` or `{{SESSION_ID}}`.
  WHY: Nothing breaks today, so this is a latent surprise only.
- TASK_GAP: requirement: Add an untrusted-body flag `_render_untrusted_body_mode` that skips the env loop. | expected_change_site: scripts/render_prompt.sh lines 337-356 and 378-395 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  EVIDENCE: The last-run diff adds only name and value predicates and two `continue` checks.
- TASK_GAP: requirement: Add `test_render_prompt_sh_does_not_substitute_env_into_untrusted_body` and `test_render_prompt_sh_refuses_secret_like_env_placeholders`. | expected_change_site: tests/test_render_prompt_foundation.py plus `main()` registration | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  EVIDENCE: The only added test sets neither untrusted-body flag.
- TASK_GAP: requirement: Append a changelog sentence with `Refs #9399, #9431, #9465`. | expected_change_site: changelog.d/9341-render-prompt-readable-errors.md | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  EVIDENCE: The fragment is unchanged and ends "Refs #9210 and #9236."
- OPERATIONAL NOTE: The PR diff and PR comment 6852727664 contain an `sk-or-v1-...` key-shaped value where the file has `{{OPENROUTER_API_KEY}}` (tests/test_render_prompt_foundation.py lines 434 and 461). Treat it as exposed and rotate the key.
- HARDENING: Set `_render_untrusted_body_mode=true` in both case arms and `continue` at the top of the loop (about 6 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 4
